speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will be asking your parent or guardian about your health. To begin, how long has your baby been feeding, and have you noticed any vomiting, diarrhea, or changes in bowel movements?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that background; it is concerning that the mother had no prenatal care and immunizations are unavailable. Given the newborn's age and lack of vaccines, have you noticed any yellowing of the skin or eyes, or a fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur (likely a Patent Ductus Arteriosus), bluish macules that do not blanch (Purpura Fulminans or "blueberry muffin" rash), and cloudy lenses (cataracts) in a newborn with no immunization history is pathognomonic for Congenital Rubella Syndrome, specifically representing the classic triad of cataracts, cardiac defects, and deafness.
